title: Allow this message
summary: Records a dl:ok review of one finding, so it stops being reported without being fixed
intro: Read this when a finding in the Structure form is a deliberate, reviewed exception rather than something to change. Right-click the finding and choose Allow this message to record a dl:ok review so it stops being reported.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint allow <file> --fix-line <L> --fix-rule <id> [--apply] [--rules-dir <dir>] [--config <file>] [--profile <name>] [--enable id,...] [--disable id,...] [--stand-in-for <realpath>] (record a dl:ok review of ONE finding; dry-run without --apply; the lint options decide which findings the line has)
